historical_reviews.deepseek: Selects the empty-request OOB branch and calls the output SOL state without source-backed response fields.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Defines the correct semantic boundary but assumes the vendor parser is already available; the repository does not contain that private specification.
historical_reviews.history: The invalidated prior-run record was found but excluded as authority; the paired setter shows why channel identity matters but cannot define getter response bytes.

original_test_intent: Read SOL enable status for one named BMC interface/channel and compare it with the approved remote-console security policy without changing access state.
original_method: Retain both 0x30/0x49 request forms and copied NTP/factory-reset text as conflict evidence; do not choose framing or decode bytes until the Wistron contract is approved.
manual_activity: The console/security owner supplies the firmware-specific 0x30/0x49 request/response contract, identifies the interface and SOL channel, and approves the expected enable/security policy.
required_inputs: Resolution of selector versus no-data request
SOL channel, interface and payload-instance mapping
Enable-state field, length and reserved-value rules
safety_requirements: Do not issue 0x30/0x48 or standard SOL SET commands
Do not factory-reset, reset or power-cycle
Do not guess selector, channel or response byte
Preserve unknown bytes without interpreting them
Do not open a SOL session as part of this state-only read
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, interface/channel and approved OEM schema
Capture relevant SOL policy and active-session context without mutation
Validate completion, length, state and reserved fields
Compare the named channel state with approved security policy
engineer_actions: Resolve request framing and copied NTP label
Approve channel identity and expected policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The bare OOB opcode may match one source branch, but it silently drops the in-band selector and lacks an approved response layout; therefore it cannot yet prove a SOL state.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After the contract is approved, issue one raw 0x30 0x49 [approved-interface-selector-if-required] request, validate the target-specific response, decode only the documented SOL state/channel fields and compare with policy.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The two transport forms and 10/5 timing are retained; copied NTP values are not treated as getter request bytes and response fields are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Pin the private getter to firmware and channel identity, preserve the full frame, validate exact response structure and compare the decoded access bit with the approved SOL security policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces unrelated reset/NTP acceptance and untyped raw output with a channel-qualified, read-only security-state report.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The getter does not prove the setter transition or end-to-end console usability; those require separate mutation/session coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A valid enable bit for the wrong channel can falsely report the intended recovery console as available or expose an unexpected interface.

project_override_considerations: Standard SOL parameter reads are equivalent only with a documented mapping to the same channel and private status field; otherwise they are corroborating evidence and 0x30/0x49 coverage remains open.
expected_evidence: Approved target/firmware/request/response contract and parser version
Resolved interface and SOL channel identity
Redacted full request/response, completion and timestamp
No SOL write, NTP, factory-reset, power or log mutation audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The in-band Procedure requires an Ethernet Interface Select, OOB sends no request data, the note describes NTP status rather than SOL response semantics, and Criteria 2 expects a factory reset. These cannot define one coherent read-only SOL getter.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intended SOL status read is identifiable. Vendor framing/decoder and channel policy are explicit prerequisites, so the case is package/user-confirmation gated rather than irreducibly BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Prevents an undocumented raw byte from becoming a security-state claim, preserves all source contradictions and scopes the result to one named SOL channel.
independent_technical_reasoning: A read-only opcode can still produce misleading evidence if its selector and response layout are unknown. Here the Master gives no SOL response definition and inserts unrelated NTP/reset text, so the private contract must establish both which channel is queried and which byte means enabled before policy comparison is possible.
